title: Abigail
summary: Raleigh names Abigail in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Abigail, named with Nabal after the death of Samuel, at that same passage of Dauid in the desart. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVI, §. V, sig. 289b–290a
